title: Understanding the Plots
text: Look at how the mean squared error (MSE) changes with the degree of the polynomial. Consider both training and validation errors.

title: Identifying Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when the model performs well on training data but poorly on validation data. Which plot shows this behavior?

title: Identifying Underfitting
text: Underfitting occurs when the model performs poorly on both training and validation data. Which plot shows this behavior?

hintAnswer: The MSE decreases initially and then increases, indicating a balance between underfitting and overfitting.
title: Analyzing Plot B
text: In Plot B, how does the MSE change as the degree increases?
choices: The MSE decreases initially and then increases
The MSE decreases initially and then increases, indicating a balance between underfitting and overfitting.
